review: INDEPENDENTLY REVIEWED SOURCE RECIPE; numeric expected approval and saved acceptance are separate artifacts. Original DOAToPTHP.idf SHA256 a73420b559c1f90061f65f6f1b6ccd6845a817d9110a7fbd5d63c266142435c6 and the unchanged closed real-pthp-25-1-20260907T163131.692144900 SQL SHA256 127a9683e6a466d1c4c84dfbb716b31932714dce101e08ac0cc05079bbf62271 were independently audited. That old capture has none of the 35 required direct coil-consumption observations at any frequency; these are missing, not zero, and its fallback-only output cannot approve this recipe. The new separately preserved real-pthp-25-1-20260908T095959.079056400 capture requests all 35 exact Monthly/J identities and reports 420 finite nonnegative full-2017 Weather observations, with no missing month, NULL or duplicate physical identity. Its SQL SHA256 is 5470d4b338f0ad78c6b050ae4c196a78d856fa03a1c511b3db8aa98bf87b3b3e and executed input SHA256 is 99a65916fa9895a3cc5d823696fbf202f4d620fa76b076fc8167be832a28dfd1. Independent original MTD membership contains exactly five Cooling Electricity, twenty Heating Electricity and ten Heating NaturalGas constituents. Annual component kWh are cooling DX 7565.922327728445, heating DX 129.0817607060335, defrost 44.544796591612524, heating crankcase 3963.256209764137, supplemental gas 1718.862453752996, supplemental electricity zero and ancillary gas zero. Monthly component-to-meter closure discrepancies are at most 2.05e-12 kWh for cooling electricity, 4.55e-13 for heating electricity and 2.84e-13 for heating gas. The crankcase contribution is genuinely observed and must not be omitted to manufacture a higher heating efficiency. Exact original MTD/RDD membership distinguishes cooling DX electricity, heating DX electricity, heating defrost electricity, heating crankcase electricity, supplemental fuel NaturalGas, supplemental ancillary NaturalGas and supplemental fuel-coil electricity. Heating Coil Electricity Energy is shared as an output name by DX and Fuel objects but not as a physical reporting identity: each exact key/type/parent/Zone must be proved separately from original IDF and executed requests. The PTHP cooling coil does not report a separate Cooling Coil Crankcase Heater Electricity Energy family; the PTAC roster is not copied. Components already represent model-total energy, never multiplied again by Zone/List factors. Direct-first allocation is carrier-qualified, complete-cohort-only and preserves known zero versus absent/NULL; no measured fallback or part of a package is invented. The five SPACE1-1 through SPACE5-1 Zones each own one PackagedTerminalHeatPump, its HP Cooling Mode DX coil, HP Heating Mode DX coil, HP Supp Coil using NaturalGas, and Supply Fan. Whole-document typed references, EquipmentList and EquipmentConnections resolve uniquely; PLENUM-1 has no equipment and both original sensible loads are known zero in all twelve months. All six original/SQL Zone factors are one, with no ZoneList or ZoneGroup. No central conditioning coil, plant loop, pump, boiler or chiller is present. The DOAS uses heat recovery, an OA mixer and a common variable-volume fan; its terminal mixers connect SPACE1-3 on the inlet side and SPACE4-5 on the supply side. Original geometry has forty BuildingSurface:Detailed plus six FenestrationSurface:Detailed objects and no InternalMass; all 46 literal names have Monthly inside-face convection Energy/J sources. Five People, Lights, ElectricEquipment and Infiltration owners match the five SPACE Zones and exact SQL key sets. All sixteen driver family memberships and all forty-two requested availability groups were separately matched against the old original Monthly SQL; no availability observation differs from its actual source identity. Sensible Zone Air System Energy/J is the delivered-load authority; equipment sensible/total thermal outputs are not added as duplicate loads or consumption. Shared heat-recovery thermal observations remain inspector context, not five invented Zone latent loads. The plenum retains its separately observed unsplit outdoor-air balance; only actual SPACE infiltration members are subtracted from outdoor-air transfer. No Ideal latent details or unobserved Hourly surface/internal reconciliation traces are declared. The old SQL contains 340 Monthly identities (331 variables and nine meters), all with twelve finite non-warmup full-2017 Weather observations, no missing month, NULL or exact dictionary duplicate. Original annual kWh are Electricity Facility 47313.66479993558, Cooling Electricity 7565.9223277284445, Heating Electricity 4136.882767061783, Heating NaturalGas and NaturalGas Facility 1718.8624537529956, Fans Electricity 1010.3597051453659, InteriorLights Electricity 23272.5 and InteriorEquipment Electricity 11328. HeatRecovery Electricity is observed zero for twelve months; Heating Electricity is positive in every month and only July Heating NaturalGas is observed zero. Monthly electricity closure is within 8.19e-12 kWh and gas closure is exact. These are original corroborating observations, not candidate-derived expected scalars. Mixed electric/gas heating is Load / site energy, never an assumed COP or combustion efficiency; the Building conversion denominator includes both exact heating carriers while their allocation ledgers remain separate. Cooling uses COP. Actual individual fan electricity is absent: the broad Fans meter contains the DOAS fan and five local fans and cannot be treated as a DOAS-only energy pool. Thirty-two original Hourly System Node Mass Flow Rate sources each have 8760 valid nonnegative values, so airflow is not claimed missing; however those flows do not independently isolate the unmeasured fan-energy pools. Broad fan energy remains explicitly unassigned. Original model bytes, sizing/geometry/equipment/schedules/timestep are preserved; only the controlled annual runtime RunPeriod and normal purpose output requests differ. The original example describes Miami while the catalog deliberately uses unchanged Chicago weather SHA256 c7d4efcf93ba316a1d874352e743df5cf137ba5c0e3459eb2dc4b5442d5b7f5c. The old engine completed in 13.29 seconds with 24523 warnings and zero Severe; warnings are retained and this result-transformation exercise is not calibration or climate/design certification. The new engine completed in 10.10 seconds with the same 24523 warnings and zero Severe/Fatal. Its first test run retained all original evidence before 103 native-versus-wire verification mismatches; it is not labeled a passing capture test. A separate strict v2 wire copy preserves observed zero and absent/NULL without altering native RunResult or saved artifacts. The remaining three saved-candidate differences are July's known-zero Building natural-gas energy reconciliation: production prunes the zero carrier node and its entire orphan accounting row. Exact independent expected, explained and signed-residual quantities must all support whole-row pruning; present missing/null fields, nonzero totals and unknown Monthly inputs are not repaired. This test-only proof does not change metric keys, numeric centers, precision or production pruning. Complete eight-group diagnostics, explicit pending-artifact review and saved expected-manifest acceptance remain separate gates; no source recipe alone approves results.
